item.title: Duolingo did not prepare me for the Super Bowl halftime show
item.description: I’ve come equipped with zero knowledge of football, three months of Duolingo Spanish and the raw, utterly unjustified confidence of a true American who once ordered at Chipotle without switching to English. The post Duolingo did not prepare me for the Super Bowl halftime show appeared first on The Stanford Daily.

item.title: UGS passes bills to secure proportional VSO funding, amend UGS election bylaws
item.description: In its Wednesday meeting, the UGS passed bills on student organization funding and the role of class presidents, heard about budget changes related to the now-dismantled Neighborhood System and advocated for more flexible free speech regulations. The post UGS passes bills to secure proportional VSO funding, amend UGS election bylaws appeared first on The Stanford Daily.

item.title: No More Excuses: Hiking the Dish
item.description: In the first installment of her column "No More Excuses," D'Souza starts her tour of campus sights by hiking the Dish trail. The post No More Excuses: Hiking the Dish appeared first on The Stanford Daily.

item.title: Read this article, win $500,000: How MrBeast sells the myth of modern wealth
item.description: MrBeast, who visited Stanford's campus last week, embodies the archetypal genie who grants wishes, or more nefariously, the devil who bargains your soul for riches. The post Read this article, win $500,000: How MrBeast sells the myth of modern wealth appeared first on The Stanford Daily.

item.title: Stanford softball suffers first loss of season against Kentucky
item.description: Stanford softball falls 11-7 to No. 25 Kentucky in the first game of the Cardinal Classic I tournament. The tournament's remaining games have been relocated. The post Stanford softball suffers first loss of season against Kentucky appeared first on The Stanford Daily.

item.title: From the Community | Federal cuts threaten postdocs: Stanford must step up
item.description: Postdoc Wesley Allen Williams writes on behalf of Stanford Postdocs United, sharing results of a survey they conducted and calling on Stanford to stand up in defense of postdocs' research and careers. The post From the Community | Federal cuts threaten postdocs: Stanford must step up appeared first on The Stanford Daily.

item.title: GSC approves resolution on student housing, proportional funding bill for SAF-supported organizations
item.description: The Graduate Student Council (GSC) approved a resolution, a bill and posed questions to The Daily’s Editor-in-Chief, George Porteous ’27. The post GSC approves resolution on student housing, proportional funding bill for SAF-supported organizations appeared first on The Stanford Daily.
